headline: PASOK Fires at Mitsotakis: "The Country Does Not Need Ludovikos" – Proposal to Reduce Excise Duty on Fuel
summary: PASOK spokesman Kostas Tsoukalas focused on fuel price hikes and called for state intervention. The party proposed reducing the excise duty on fuel.
why: Excise duties form part of the retail fuel price in Greece, so changes to them affect consumer costs and government tax revenue.
